name: The First Circuit
synopsis: A seasonal gale has left the Wakeward Isles' shared ferries, clinics, stores, and beacons working from different pieces of yesterday's plan. You are a newly appointed circuit runner: part courier, part witness, and part keeper of the public record. Veteran routekeeper Mara Venn accompanies you for the first circuit, offering what she knows and lending a hand without taking the route away from you. The work is practical and hopeful. Nobody needs defeating; the islands need reliable handoffs, honest revisions, and enough people willing to finish a shared task.

characters.name: You
characters.description: A new circuit runner in a blue weather cape, carrying a clean route book and the alert expression of someone entrusted with real work on their first morning.
characters.personality: Observant, responsible, and free to decide when to ask, when to act, and when to leave a sound plan alone.
characters.knownLore: The circuit badge authorizes you to carry notices and sign public handoffs, but local specialists remain the authority on their own work.
characters.backstory: The island councils appointed you after a season assisting local couriers. This is the first route for which your signature will become part of the common record.

scenes.name: A Route Worth Sharing
scenes.setup: Morning light returns to Bellharbor after the seasonal gale. Crews have cleared the quay, but the public route board carries six green revision slips: clinic tonic for Lowmere, a changed ferry bell, a lens calibration, a fast-squall warning, a shared-store repair, and one cargo line that no longer agrees with its seal. Mara Venn waits beside the board with a weatherproof satchel. 'First circuit,' she says. 'We check what changed, help where a second pair of hands matters, and leave alone what is already sound.' Pax Lorne is comparing ferry loads while Nia Wren sorts damp manifests at the tally desk.

quests.name: Cold Passage
quests.description: Protect a crate of blueglass tonic from direct sun and deliver it to Reedbank Clinic before the afternoon heat.
quests.deadlineFailText: The clinic's safe delivery window closes. Sori arranges a later cooled crossing; nobody is harmed, but this circuit can no longer claim the timely handoff.

objectives.description: Collect the tonic in an insulated wrap at the Relay House
Deliver the protected crate to Reedbank Clinic

quests.name: Second Bell
quests.description: Confirm the gale-day second-bell ferry plan and reach the Cinderhook drydock through the service gate before its repair berth turns over.
quests.deadlineFailText: The second-bell berth turns over to the next listed repair. Pax reschedules the inspection without penalty, but the expedited window is gone.

objectives.description: Confirm the current second-bell load at the Ferry Yard
Reach the Cinderhook drydock repair berth

quests.name: Clear Glass
quests.description: Carry the current clear-blue lens pair from Signal Glassworks and verify its spring calibration at Far Beacon.
quests.deadlineFailText: The daylight calibration interval passes. Ren secures the beacon for tomorrow's test; the network remains on its conservative night signal meanwhile.

objectives.description: Collect the current-pattern lens from Signal Glassworks
Deliver and calibrate the lens at Far Beacon

quests.name: True Bearing
quests.description: Carry Highwake's signed pressure trace to Bellharbor so ferry crews can use the cove route before the fast squall.
quests.deadlineFailText: The fast squall reaches the outer lane. Crews wait it out in sheltered water; the warning was still useful, but the early routing window has passed.

objectives.description: Collect the signed weather chart at the Weather House
Post the safe cove bearing at Bellharbor Quay

quests.name: Shared Stores
quests.description: Carry the correctly measured pump seal from Cinderhook to Highwake so its rain-tank reserve can rejoin the shared allocation.
quests.deadlineFailText: Highwake keeps its reserve on manual draw for another day. The commons rebalance deliveries; service is slower, not lost.

objectives.description: Collect the measured pump seal from Cinderhook Drydock
Deliver the seal to the Highwake Weather House

quests.name: Missing Manifest
quests.description: Reconcile why crate seventeen appears on both the clinic and drydock lists, identify the good-faith copying error, and restore one trustworthy public manifest.
quests.deadlineFailText: The disputed crate stays sealed while the offices perform a slower joint recount. Supplies remain safe, but today's circuit closes without a reconciled manifest.

objectives.description: Compare the quay, Relay House, and drydock cargo records
Identify and substantiate the copying error

effects.text: Lio checks the tonic seal while Mara fits the insulated wrap. The crate is cool, shaded, and signed into your custody.
Sori checks the cool seal, signs the clinic receipt, and shelves the tonic. The protected handoff is complete.
The live slate confirms Pax's revision: repair crews board at second bell, after the clinic crate and before market freight.
Bera logs your arrival against the second-bell berth. The repair crew has exactly the access window it expected.
Jalen lays the clear-blue pair into felt and points out the current spring alignment marks before signing the handoff.
Ren seats the lenses in the stamped order. The test flash returns clean and even across the water.
Edda signs the pressure trace and circles the cove bearing that stays sheltered during the fast squall.
Pax copies the signed cove bearing onto the live slate. Departing crews acknowledge the safer line.
Bera checks the ring against the measured card, then wraps the correct copper seal for Highwake's pump.
The seal sits flush and the rain-tank pump holds pressure. Highwake's reserve returns to the shared ledger.
The Ferry Yard carbon copy places crate seventeen on the drydock line and carries an unrevised morning timestamp.
The Relay House revision book moves crate seventeen to Reedbank Clinic and bears a later countersignature.
Nia compares the papers without excuse. Her green correction reached the seal after the Ferry Yard copy had already left: a copied old line, not a missing crate.

truth.method: Nia copied the first quay line before the Relay House revision arrived, then corrected the cargo seal without recalling the Ferry Yard carbon copy.
truth.motive: She was trying to publish the gale-day load quickly enough to keep essential cargo moving; the mistake was hurried, ordinary, and acknowledged once shown.
truth.summary: Crate seventeen was never missing or duplicated. One superseded copy survived beside the corrected seal.

facts.text: The Ferry Yard carbon copy lists crate seventeen for the drydock and predates the revision.
The later Relay House copy assigns crate seventeen to Reedbank Clinic and is properly countersigned.
Nia's green correction appears on the cargo seal but not on the already-dispatched carbon copy.
Drydock and clinic custody counts together account for every listed crate.

redHerrings.text: A damp corner suggests the missing line washed away in the gale.

successEffects.text: Nia signs the correction, and Ivo posts one reconciled manifest for all three services. The error becomes part of the audit trail instead of a secret.

wrongAccusationEffects.text: The records do not support that account yet. Mara leaves the question open and returns to the documents.

failEffects.text: The group pauses formal findings and sends the manifests to a joint recount. Nothing is lost, though the circuit closes without a same-day answer.
